It exceeds the shipped 8 MiB retention limit only when a test lowers it, which is what tests/test_attachments.py does rather than commit 11 MB of base64 to a public repository; under that lowered limit the part is hashed, its size and sha256 are recorded and its bytes are dropped, so the deep-analysis component must refuse it instead of analyzing nothing and reporting an empty container.
